ARCHITECTURE

A controlled agent, not a chatbot.

PatchPilot owns state, tools, policy, approvals, and evidence around a bounded reasoning model.

INPUTGitHub issueUntrusted content
→
PATCHPILOT CONTROL PLANE
01 State machine02 Policy engine03 Approval service04 Audit store
→
OUTPUTDraft pull requestVerified evidence
01

Inspect & reproduce

Read bounded repository context and run the configured baseline test. If the defect cannot be reproduced, the run stops safely.

02

Plan & pause

Create a typed repair plan with expected files, risks, assumptions, and verification commands. A human must approve it.

03

Patch & verify

Generate a minimal unified diff, validate it against policy, apply it, and execute the approved verification commands.

04

Review & publish

Check scope and evidence, request a second approval, then create a draft PR. V1 cannot merge or deploy.
